title: Stop review admission timing out worker hardening tests under host load
body: Outcome: review admission red-first of test/worker/hardening.test.ts does not report head=timeout when the host is loaded by foreign processes. Evidence PR #188 (t-5npejnh): admission refused 'FAIL test/worker/hardening.test.ts: head: timeout' at load 24-26 (seo-audit unlighthouse, olx curl scraping), .krn/runs/lead/worker-outcome/review-1.txt; the same head passed krn verify at load 7 (verify-1.log) and admission at load <12 (review-1b.txt). Find which subtest or deadline expires (driver result deadline timeoutMs+25000, fixture waits) and make it independent of CPU contention, or record it as a D12 flake naming the failing subtest. Proof: the file passes admission red-first under synthetic CPU load.
